sources.facts: The producer names Parfum de Terroir, Renaissance and Genesis and describes premium and super-premium production. No common measured price order between Renaissance and Genesis is established.
The catalog confirms named families and the separate Genesis Blanc de Blancs. The selected map does not claim full current coverage. Glow and Eklego remain snapshot-only navigation groups.
The official card identifies 100 percent Chardonnay and records tirage and disgorgement dates. The saved producer subset has no sparkling Genesis card. No unsupported dosage category is assigned.
